name: report
shape: A published research report. Several sections, each carrying its own argument.
template: Cover, executive summary, four to six sections with openers, working pages, methodology, appendix.
measuredFrom: The same strict published population as the brief profile. Census run 2026-08-26.
notes: Every page-level constant here is identical to the brief profile, and that is a finding rather than an oversight. The census measured page-level craft across the published population without splitting it by document length, and nothing in it suggests a longer research piece writes a denser page or a longer title. Only the page budget and the section template differ.
Should a later census split the population by length and find the page-level numbers diverge, these two files stop being duplicates and the difference goes here.

voice.framesPerDeck is 1, shared with every profile. It comes from the rule in noland-advisory-voice's catalogue rather than from a measurement, so nothing about it is shape-specific: one instance of a catalogued construction can be load-bearing in any document, and a recurring frame is the tell in any document.
